definitions.explanation: A prefix attached to nouns to indicate only one of a pair or set, or that something is incomplete or one-sided. Often implies an imbalance or that the counterpart is absent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{片手|かたて}→片手：13462_katate⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: Hold the luggage with one hand.

examples.japanese: {片足|かたあし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Standing on one foot is surprisingly difficult.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{片方|かたほう}→片方：03044_katahou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧しか⟦{反映|はんえい}していない→反映する：17186_haneisuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{一方|いっぽう}→一方：01739_ippou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧みよう。
examples.english: His account only reflects one side's opinion, so let's hear from the other side too.

notes:
A productive prefix meaning "one of a pair" or "one-sided." Attaches directly to nouns, especially body parts and paired objects, to indicate only one is involved.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{片手|かたて}→片手：13462_katate⟧: one hand
- {片足|かたあし}: one foot/leg
- ⟦{片目|かため}→片目：20229_katame⟧: one eye
- ⟦{片耳|かたみみ}→片耳：26319_katamimi⟧: one ear
- ⟦{片方|かたほう}→片方：03044_katahou⟧: one side; one of a pair
- ⟦{片道|かたみち}→片道：00199_katamichi⟧: one way (trip)
- ⟦{片思|かたおも}い→片思い：16834_kataomoi⟧: unrequited love
- ⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧: to tidy up; to put away
- ⟦{片隅|かたすみ}→片隅：13464_katasumi⟧: a corner; an out-of-the-way spot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{半|はん}→半：10460_han⟧: half — indicates an equal division into two (e.g., ⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧), while {片|かた} implies one of a natural pair
- ⟦{一方|いっぽう}→一方：01739_ippou⟧: one side — a standalone noun/adverb rather than a prefix; used more abstractly

USAGE:
When {片|かた} modifies a relationship or action, it often carries a sense of incompleteness or imbalance. ⟦{片思|かたおも}い→片思い：16834_kataomoi⟧ (one-sided love) implies the feeling is not returned. ⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧ originally meant to put things to one side, hence "tidy up."
